origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 库 (storehouse) as the sound: trousers. Simplified from 褲 by using the simplified 库.

ety.hint: A hot iron used to brand prisoners and slaves

origin.says: Traditionally a chisel or spike used to tattoo criminals, hence pain and toil; another reading sees fresh tree shoots. Bitter, hard work and the eighth heavenly stem.

辛.name: bitter spike
辛.in: 避辞辩壁辜辟辨辣臂宰譬劈瓣僻辫霹锌薛璧孽

撒.def: to disperse, to let go, to relax

ety.hint: To scatter 散 seeds by hand 扌; 散 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 散 (scatter) for the sound and meaning: to scatter by hand, to let go.

撒.name: sprinkle

ety.hint: Vines growing with a melon at their base

origin.says: A drawing of a melon hanging from its vine: melon, gourd, squash.
犭 (dog, beast) for the meaning plus 良 (good) as the sound: the wolf.

爬.def: to climb, to scramble; to crawl, to creep

origin.says: 爪 (claw) for the meaning plus 巴 as the sound: to move with hands and claws, to crawl, to climb.

爬.name: crawl

朵.def: cluster of flowers; earlobe; an item on both sides

ety.hint: Flowers 几 blooming on a tree 木

origin.says: A plant stalk with something hanging from it, a drooping blossom. The stalk became 木 (tree) and the hanging mark became 几 (small table): flower, counting word for flowers.

朵.name: flower head

瞧.def: to glance at, to look at, to see

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 焦 (scorched) as the sound: to look at, to take a peek.

瞧.name: peek

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 冈 (ridge) as the sound: a hill, then a lookout post on it, hence a post or position. Simplified from 崗 (岡 to 冈).
Simplified from 濕: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 㬎 (threads in the sun) as the sound: wet, damp. 㬎 was shortened to the 显 (show) shape.

ety.hint: A wooden 木 bridge built 刅 over a river 氵

origin.says: 氵 (water) and 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 刅 (wound) as the sound: a wooden bridge over water, hence bridge and roof beam.
大 (big man) for the meaning plus 于 (to go; written like 亏) as the sound: big, grand. Simplified Chinese also uses it for 誇 (to boast, with 言 speech).
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 尼 (nun) as the sound: wet earth, mud.

ety.hint: Wood 木 so soft it can be cut 矛

origin.says: 木 (tree, wood) for the meaning plus 矛 (spear) as the sound: young wood that bends, hence soft and supple. One reading takes 矛 as meaning too (wood fit for a spear shaft).

ety.hint: Something tasty 甘 to the tongue 舌

origin.says: 舌 (tongue) next to 甘 (sweet): sweetness tasted on the tongue.
力 (strength) for the meaning plus 巠 (warp threads, taut) as the sound: taut strength, vigour. Simplified from 勁 by writing 巠 as 𢀖.
瓦 (pottery) for the meaning plus 并 (combine) as the sound: an earthenware bottle or vase.

ety.hint: A solider 兵 quartered under one's roof 宀

origin.says: Traditional 賓 showed someone coming into a house 宀 (roof) with a gift 貝 (shell, money): a guest. The simplified form keeps 宀 and replaces the rest with 兵 (soldier) as the sound part.

振.def: to arouse, to excite; to rouse, to shake

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 辰 (clam hoe) as the sound: to shake, to rouse.

振.name: shake up

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 辟 (law) as the sound: an earthen wall.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 呂 (twin blocks) as the sound: a companion, one of a pair. Simplified from 侶 like 吕.

ety.hint: A dragon 龙 inside a house 广

origin.says: Simplified from 龐: 广 (house) for the meaning plus 龍 (dragon) as the sound: a tall house, hence huge; also confused, messy. 龍 is written 龙.

躲.def: to evade, to escape; to hide, to take shelter

origin.says: 身 (body) for the meaning plus 朵 (blossom) as the sound: to move the body away, to hide or dodge.

躲.name: dodge

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 易 (easy) as the sound: to kick.
Simplified from 鋒: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 夆 (meet) as the sound, the point of a blade. The metal side is written 钅.
冎 (a drawing of a bone joint, the top part) with ⺝ (flesh) added below to tell it apart: bone. One reading takes 冎 as the sound part.
犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 孟 (eldest) as the sound: a strong, fierce dog; then fierce and violent.

渴.def: thirsty, parched; to yearn, to pine for

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound. It first meant water drying up, then 'thirsty' and 'to long for'.

渴.name: thirsty

屏.def: screen, shield; to put aside, to reject; to hold

origin.says: 尸 (body, building) for the meaning plus 并 (combine) as the sound: a screen or shield that shuts something off.

屏.name: screen

origin.says: Traditional 莊: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 壯 (strong) as the sound. The simplified form is an old informal shape, 广 (building) over 土 (earth), that replaced both parts: a village, a manor.

亏.def: to lose, to fail; loss, damages; deficient

origin.says: An old variant of 于 (breath going out), used as the meaning part of 虧 (to lack, lose). The simplification kept only that part: loss, deficit.

亏.name: loss

origin.says: 辛 (a blade for punishment) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: a crime, guilt.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 参 (join) as the sound: a pained heart, miserable and cruel. Simplified from 慘, with 參 shortened to 参.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 真 (true) as the sound: a careful heart, cautious.
刀 (knife) for the meaning plus 龹 (two hands rolling something) as the sound: old contracts were cut in two with a knife, each side keeping half. Now a ticket or certificate.
金 (metal) for the meaning plus 咼 (crooked mouth) as the sound: a metal cooking pot. Simplified as 钅 and 呙.
A drawing of a ram's head with its curved horns: sheep or goat.

羊.name: sheep
羊.in: 样着群差善洋详鲜羞氧祥翔痒搓羚癣

舍.def: house, dwelling; to reside, to dwell; to abandon, to give up

origin.says: From 余 (a drawing of a hut) with 口 (here just a mark, not mouth) added: a house, lodging. The parts later fused to look like 人 (person) over 舌 (tongue). It also replaces 捨 (扌 hand + 舍: to give up).

舍.name: cottage

旋.def: to revolve, to orbit, to return

ety.hint: An army 方 marching under a flag 疋

origin.says: 㫃 (flag) plus 止 (foot) and a circle: people marching round under a flag, to turn, to revolve. The foot and circle merged into a shape like 疋 (bolt of cloth).

旋.name: revolve

宠.def: to love; to favor, to pamper, to spoil; concubine

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 龙 (dragon) as the sound: someone favoured in the house, to pamper. Simplified from 寵, with 龍 written 龙.

宠.name: pamper

origin.says: 龙 (dragon) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: a ridge of earth in a field, a grave mound. Simplified from 壟, with 龍 written 龙.

戒.def: to warn, to admonish; to swear off, to avoid

ety.hint: Two hands 廾 brandishing a spear 戈

origin.says: 戈 (halberd) held up by 廾 (two hands): standing guard, hence to warn and to guard against.

戒.name: on guard

慰.def: to calm, to comfort, to reassure

origin.says: 尉 (officer; first 'to press smooth') as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: to smooth a troubled heart, to comfort.

慰.name: comfort

ety.hint: Losing 亡 one's sight 目; 亡 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亡 (lose) as the sound plus 目 (eye) for the meaning: eyes that have lost their sight, blind.
光 (light) for the meaning plus 军 (army) as the sound: brightness, radiance. Simplified from 輝 (軍 to 军).

阔.def: ample, broad, wide; separate; to be apart

origin.says: 门 (gate) for the meaning plus 活 (alive) as the sound: wide, broad. Simplified from 闊, 門 shortened to 门.

阔.name: broad

劝.def: to recommend, to advise; to urge, to exhort

ety.hint: The power 力 beside 又 the throne

origin.says: Simplified from 勸: 力 (strength) for the meaning plus 雚 as the sound: to put effort into urging someone. The simplified form replaces 雚 with the stand-in 又 (hand).

劝.name: urge

origin.says: 高 (tall) with its bottom dropped, as the sound, plus 豕 (pig, boar) for the meaning: first a bristly boar, then strong, bold, heroic.
手 (hand) for the meaning plus 龹 (rolling hands) as the sound, which also hints at curling: a hand curled up, the fist.

叙.def: to express, to state; to relate, to narrate

origin.says: 余 (surplus) as the sound plus a hand part: to arrange in order, hence to relate, to narrate. Simplified from 敘, with 攵 (hand striking) replaced by 又 (hand), an old variant.

叙.name: relate

ety.hint: A beast 兄 with two horns 丷

origin.says: A person (人, now 儿) with a 口 (mouth) and two strokes, 八, coming out of it: speech, first meaning 'to speak' (later 说) and 'pleased'. Now used for 'to exchange'.

筹.def: chip, tally, token; to plan; to raise money

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 寿 (long life) as the sound: bamboo counting sticks or tallies, hence to plan and to raise funds. Simplified from 籌.

筹.name: tally stick

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: a glad, pleased heart.
舌 (tongue) for the meaning plus 忝 (to shame) as the sound: to lick.

溃.def: a flooding river; a military defeat; to break down, to disperse

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 贵 (expensive) as the sound: water bursting a dyke; then a rout, to collapse. Simplified from 潰.

溃.name: burst dyke

ety.hint: A ditch 洰 made of wood 木; 洰 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: One reading: 氵 (water) plus a shortened 榘 (carpenter's square) as the sound; another: 洰 (a water name) over 木 (wood). Either way, a channel dug for water.
心 (heart) for the meaning plus 兹 as the sound: a kind, loving heart, as a parent's.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 黄 (yellow) as the sound: a wooden bar lying across, so horizontal, crosswise, and then unruly.
饣 (food) for the meaning plus 并 (combine) as the sound: a flat cake or biscuit. Simplified from 餅 (the food side became 饣).

宿.def: to stop, to rest, to lodge; constellation

ety.hint: A person 亻 sleeping in a bed 百 under a roof 宀

origin.says: 亻 (person) lying on a mat (the mat later written 百 (hundred)) under 宀 (roof): resting for the night, to lodge; also a star 'lodge' of the sky.

宿.name: lodge overnight

origin.says: Simplified from 賊. It was first 則 (rule) as the sound plus 戈 (dagger-axe, weapon): one who attacks with weapons. Later the shape was reread as 贝 (money) plus 戎 (weapons): an armed man after money, a thief.
犭 (dog, beast) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: vicious like a fierce animal.
辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 䍃 (a pot shape) as the sound: a long way to go, distant.
Simplified from 濫: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 監 (supervise) as the sound: water flooding over, excessive. It uses the simplified 监.

欠.def: to lack, to owe; to breathe, to yawn

origin.says: A picture of a kneeling person with the mouth wide open: yawning or breathing out. 'To lack, to owe' is a later borrowed sense.

欠.name: yawn
欠.in: 资次欢款欧歌软欲盗饮歉欣咨吹欺姿砍瓷掀羡歇嗽嵌钦炊坎漱

赔.def: to compensate, to pay damages, to suffer a loss

origin.says: Simplified from 賠: 貝 (shell, money) became 贝. 贝 (money) for the meaning plus 咅 (spit) as the sound: making amends with money, 'to compensate'.

赔.name: compensate

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 台 (platform) as the sound: the embryo in the womb; later also a tyre.

妨.def: damage, harm; to impede, to obstruct; to undermine

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: to hinder, obstruct, harm.

妨.name: hinder

瞬.def: to wink, to blink; an instant, the blink of an eye

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 舜 (a sage king) as the sound: a blink of the eye, an instant.

瞬.name: blink

origin.says: A character made for writing Sanskrit sounds (as in bodhisattva), blended from a variant of 薛 with 土 (earth) added, later shaped like 艹 over 阝 and 產 (produce). Simplified from 薩 with 产 for 產.

淘.def: to dredge, to sieve; to cleanse, to weed out

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 匋 (pottery-making) as the sound: to wash in a sieve, to sift out and weed out.

淘.name: sieve

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 艾 (mugwort) as the sound: a cry of surprise.
鬼 (ghost) for the meaning plus 麻 (hemp) as the sound. It was made to write a Buddhist word for a destroying demon: demon, magic.

押.def: to arrest, to detain; to deposit, to pledge; mortgage

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 甲 (shell armor) as the sound: to press down, hence to detain or to pledge.

押.name: pledge

origin.says: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 畐 (full jar) as the sound: the spokes of a wheel. Simplified from 輻, 車 shortened to 车.
